source_documents.role: The current audit identifies acceptance of packageRoots on configuration records as a policy enforcement gap.
The current verifier validates packageRoots format only for packaged extension solution types and ignores the field on configuration, profile-patch, and skill records.
The current focused suite covers valid packaged roots and unrelated classification errors but has no forbidden-packageRoots fixtures.
The existing upstream-safe-customization-governance record owns the verifier and its focused specification, so no competing policy owner is needed.

findings.summary: An extension record with solutionType configuration and packageRoots is accepted with no diagnostic, even though configuration does not ship package source and must not claim package roots.
findings.limitations: The probe used an in-memory policy record and did not alter the checked-in policy.

findings.summary: The focused policy suite has no invalid fixtures for packageRoots on configuration, profile-patch, or skill solution types, so the false-green path is not protected by an executable test.
findings.limitations: The existing positive packaged-extension fixture remains valid and must continue to pass after the correction.

implementation_scope: Reject packageRoots when an extension solutionType is configuration, profile-patch, or skill.
Add one focused invalid fixture for each non-packaged extension type with an actionable diagnostic.
Preserve the required packageRoots validation for plugin, bundle, plugin-and-bundle, library, and capability-seam records.
Keep the existing policy improvement ownership and do not introduce a second owner for the verifier paths.
compatibility_obligations: Existing valid packaged-extension records continue to pass.
Configuration, profile-patch, and skill records without packageRoots continue to pass.
No runtime package or released Session data changes.
The diagnostic names the offending record and forbidden field.

decision.result: AAA-016:A01 PASS — false-green packageRoots acceptance reproduced and bounded implementation scope specified
decision.diagnosis: The verifier's current conditional validates malformed package roots for packaged extensions but silently accepts the same field on non-packaged extension records. The existing governance owner and focused test file are the correct implementation surfaces.
decision.next_action: Bind the implementation-ready gate and add the forbidden-packageRoots rule with configuration, profile-patch, and skill invalid fixtures.

commands: node --input-type=module -e import validateCustomizationPolicy and probe configuration with packageRoots
